title: Kangaskhan Sleeps Standing to Protect Its Baby

direction.premise: Kangaskhan always sleeps standing up so it will not crush the baby in its pouch.
direction.audiencePromise: See why Kangaskhan turns sleep into a standing safety rule for its baby.
direction.openLoop: Can Kangaskhan protect its baby without lying down?
direction.payoff: Standing avoids crushing the baby during sleep.
direction.engagementQuestion: Best parenting move, or too big a sacrifice?

voice.instructions: Sound like a knowledgeable fan sharing a surprising fact. Speak warmly and quickly, with sharp pauses before each reveal. Stress standing, three years, and crushed. Keep the final question playful and genuinely open.

scenes.headline: STANDING OR CRUSHED
scenes.narration: Kangaskhan sleeps standing, or risks crushing its baby.
scenes.caption: SLEEP MEANS STAYING UPRIGHT

scenes.headline: THE BABY RIDES INSIDE
scenes.narration: Its baby is carried in a pouch on its belly.
scenes.caption: THE BABY STAYS IN A BELLY POUCH

scenes.headline: THREE YEARS IN THE POUCH
scenes.narration: That infant rarely leaves its mother's pouch until three years old.
scenes.caption: THE PROTECTION LASTS FOR YEARS

scenes.headline: NO LYING DOWN
scenes.narration: So Kangaskhan always sleeps standing up to avoid crushing the baby.
scenes.caption: STANDING AVOIDS CRUSHING THE BABY

scenes.headline: A POSTURE WITH PURPOSE
scenes.narration: Its strangest sleeping posture is really a protective design.
scenes.caption: NOT A QUIRK. A SAFETY SYSTEM.

scenes.headline: SMART OR TOO MUCH?
scenes.narration: Best parenting move, or too big a sacrifice?
scenes.caption: SAFETY FIRST OR EASIER SLEEP?
